environment_variable_names.description: Names of every environment variable this module sets on the relay. Lets a contract test assert the config surface in both directions — nothing the relay reads is unset, nothing set is unread.

function_name.description: The relay function's name. Consumed by `modules/frontend_cdn` to attach the CloudFront-scoped `lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl` permission.

function_url.description: The Function URL, scheme and trailing slash included, as Lambda returns it.

function_url_domain.description: Host portion of the Function URL, for use as a CloudFront custom-origin `domain_name` (which rejects a scheme or a path).

log_group_name.description: The relay's CloudWatch log group name.

role_arn.description: The relay execution role's ARN. Consumed by the Layer 4 `simulate-principal-policy` check.

agent_runtime_arn.description:
ARN of the one AgentCore Runtime this relay may invoke
(`module.agentcore.agent_runtime_arn`). The execution role is granted
`bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntime` on this ARN and its endpoint sub-resources and on nothing
else — no wildcard, no second runtime.

agent_runtime_qualifier.description:
Runtime endpoint qualifier the relay invokes, passed to the relay as `AGENT_RUNTIME_QUALIFIER`
(`src/relay/src/runtime.ts`). The execution role's `InvokeAgentRuntime` grant covers the endpoint
this value names.

cognito_audience_parameter_arn.description:
ARN of that same parameter, for the execution role's `ssm:GetParameter` grant. The caller constructs
it from region, account and name, not from `aws_ssm_parameter.…arn`, to avoid a module cycle.

cognito_audience_parameter_name.description:
Name of the SSM parameter holding the SPA app-client id the relay requires. The relay reads it at
cold start and rejects any token issued to a different client.

cognito_issuer.description: Cognito user-pool issuer URL (`https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<pool-id>`). The relay derives its JWKS URL from this and rejects any token whose `iss` differs.

eni_function_code_deny_policy_arn.description: ARN of the managed policy denying the Hyperplane ENI actions to function code (`modules/eni_function_code_deny`). Attached to this function's role.

environment_kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the function environment variables and its log group.

filename.description: Path to the relay deployment package built by `scripts/package_relay.sh`.

function_name.description: Unique Lambda function name. Also names this module's IAM role and log group.

handler.description: Lambda handler entry point inside the relay zip.

log_retention_days.description: Explicit CloudWatch Logs retention for the relay's log group.

memory_size_mb.description: Lambda memory allocation in MB, sizing the Node runtime and the JWKS cache.

reserved_concurrent_executions.description:
Reserved concurrency for the relay. Must be greater than zero; 0 makes the function permanently
uninvokable.

One chat turn holds one invocation for up to `timeout_seconds`. The caller keeps the sum of every
reserved concurrency in the deployment below the account pool minus unreserved headroom.

No default; the caller states a value.

runtime.description: Lambda runtime identifier. Must be a Node.js runtime, which supports response streaming.

source_code_hash.description: Base64-encoded SHA256 of the relay package, forcing redeploy on code change.

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already carries the mandatory tags; this adds or overrides per-resource.

timeout_seconds.description: Lambda invocation timeout in seconds. Must exceed the 600s chat turn wall clock.

vpc_security_group_ids.description:
Security groups for the relay's ENIs (`module.vpc.lambda_security_group_ids`). The group has no
ingress; the relay is invoked through the Lambda control plane (a signed Function URL invoke).

vpc_subnet_ids.description:
Private subnet ids the relay's Hyperplane ENIs are placed in (`module.vpc.lambda_subnet_ids`).
Required, with no default; at least two subnets.

The relay's outbound calls (`bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgentRuntime`, `ssm:GetParameter` and the
Cognito JWKS fetch) leave through these subnets, via the VPC endpoints and the NAT gateway. A missing
path presents as a hung turn, not as an authorization error.

agent_runtime_log_group_arn.description: CloudWatch Logs group ARN for the AgentCore Runtime's default endpoint stdout, for scoping the execution role's logs:* grant.

agent_runtime_log_group_name.description: CloudWatch Logs group name for the AgentCore Runtime's default endpoint stdout.

codebuild_role_arn.description: ARN of the CodeBuild image-build project's service role, which reads the agent-source object and uses its CMK. The root admits it to the eval-artefacts bucket and key policies.

ecr_repository_arn.description:
ARN of the ECR repository the agent container image is pushed to. The root composition scopes the
AgentCore Runtime execution role's `ecr:BatchGetImage`/`ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer` grant to this
ARN.

ecr_repository_url.description: The ECR repository URL the agent container image is pushed to.

gateway_target_ids.description: Map of tool_name -> that tool's gateway target id, one entry per entry in var.tool_lambda_arns.

description.constant_value: Builds and pushes the AgentCore Runtime container image.

agent_runtime_environment_variables.description: Plaintext environment variables for the runtime. Anything sensitive must instead be a Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store reference resolved at runtime, never an inline secret value.

agent_runtime_name.description: Name for the AgentCore Runtime resource. Must satisfy the CreateAgentRuntime pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,47} -- no hyphens.

agent_runtime_role_arn.description: Execution role ARN the AgentCore Runtime assumes to run the agent container.

aws_profile.description: Named AWS CLI profile used by the in-apply CodeBuild trigger's `local-exec` provisioner.

aws_region.description: AWS region for the AgentCore resources and the in-apply build trigger.

buildspec.description: Inline buildspec for the CodeBuild project (Docker build + ECR push steps).

cognito_allowed_audiences.description: Accepted `aud` claim values for the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.

cognito_allowed_client_ids.description: App client ids accepted as valid callers by the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.

cognito_allowed_scopes.description: Scopes required to be present on an inbound access token, enforced by the Gateway CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.

cognito_discovery_url.description: Cognito user pool OIDC discovery URL, ending in /.well-known/openid-configuration.

cognito_required_custom_claims.description:
Custom claims the Gateway CUSTOM_JWT authorizer requires on an inbound token, each matched by
equality against one fixed `required_value` (for example a fixed `token_use` claim). Presence-only
checks are not expressible here; the interceptor's `decode_identity` rejects a token without the
identity claims. Defaults to empty.

data_classification.description: Value for the mandatory `data-classification` tag, applied per-resource (mirrors every sibling module's convention).

ecr_repository_name.description: Name of the ECR repository holding the agent container image.

gateway_name.description: Name for the AgentCore Gateway resource.

gateway_role_arn.description: Execution role ARN the Gateway assumes, including to invoke each target Lambda via credential_provider_configuration.gateway_iam_role.

identity_interceptor_lambda_arn.description: Invoke ARN of the identity_interceptor Lambda (src/gateway/identity_interceptor.py), attached as the Gateway's REQUEST interceptor.

identity_interceptor_lambda_function_nam.description: Function name of the identity_interceptor Lambda, used to grant this Gateway invoke permission in the function resource policy.

image_retention_count.description: Number of most-recent tagged images retained by the ECR lifecycle policy.

image_tag.description: Tag applied to the image the agent_runtime resource consumes (e.g. a short content-hash-derived tag the caller mints alongside source_content_hash).

kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the ECR repository and the module's CloudWatch Logs log groups (runtime and CodeBuild) at rest.

log_retention_days.description: Explicit CloudWatch Logs retention for the CodeBuild project's log group.

name_prefix.description: Prefix applied to the CodeBuild project, its IAM role, and its log group names.

platform_version.description:
AgentCore Runtime `platformVersion`: "V1" or "V2". V2 restores each instance from a
prepared snapshot; creates and updates take minutes. Switching either way is an in-place update.
Rollback: set "V1" and apply (docs/runbook.md).

runtime_network_mode.description:
AgentCore Runtime `networkMode`: "PUBLIC" or "VPC". VPC mode places the microVM's ENIs in the
adopted VPC's Runtime subnets on a dedicated no-ingress security group; it governs egress only.
Defaults to "PUBLIC"; the root composition sets "VPC" and wires the subnet and security-group
variables.

runtime_security_group_ids.description:
Security group ids for the Runtime's VPC-mode ENIs. Required (at least one) when
runtime_network_mode is "VPC"; ignored under "PUBLIC". Must be the dedicated Runtime security group
(no ingress, egress only to the endpoint security group and the gateway prefix lists), not the
Lambda security group.

runtime_subnet_ids.description:
Subnet ids for the Runtime's VPC-mode ENIs. Required (at least one) when runtime_network_mode is
"VPC"; ignored under "PUBLIC". Set through the gitignored tfvars.

Every subnet must be in an AgentCore-supported AZ for the region (`infra/regions.json`);
`scripts/preflight_adopted_vpc.sh` asserts that at deploy time.

source_bucket_arn.description: S3 bucket ARN holding the zipped agent source CodeBuild reads from as its `source`.

source_content_hash.description:
Content hash of the agent source tree, used as this module's `null_resource.image_build` trigger
value. The image build re-runs when this value changes between applies.

source_key.description: S3 object key, within source_bucket_arn, of the zipped agent source archive.

source_kms_key_arn.description:
ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting `source_bucket_arn`'s objects at rest, also used as
the CodeBuild project's `encryption_key`. The CodeBuild role is granted `kms:Decrypt`,
`kms:Encrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey*` and `kms:DescribeKey` on exactly this key. The key's own
policy must also admit `aws_iam_role.codebuild` (or a broader principal it belongs to).

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already covers the mandatory tags; this allows a per-resource override or addition.

tool_lambda_arns.description:
Map of tool_name -> that tool's action Lambda ARN (`module.lambda_action[tool_name].function_arn`),
one entry per tool in `crm.toolspec.definitions.ALL_TOOLS`. Each entry produces exactly one gateway
target. Its keys are a superset of the `api` module's tool routes: `get_page_context` is reachable
by the agents and the Gateway but has no HTTP route (`local.agent_only_tools` in `infra/main.tf`).
That the key set equals `ALL_TOOLS` is `scripts/check_toolspec_parity.py`'s check on
`local.tools`, which this map is built from.

tool_schemas.description:
Map of tool_name -> that tool's flattened MCP tool schema, for the required
`target_configuration.mcp.lambda.tool_schema` block of each `aws_bedrockagentcore_gateway_target`.
Carries exactly the keys of `tool_lambda_arns`; the gateway target resource's precondition fails
the plan otherwise.

The root composition derives each entry's `description` and `properties` from
`crm.toolspec.definitions.ALL_TOOLS[tool_name]` (`.description` and the top-level keys of
`.input_schema["properties"]`).

Only top-level scalar properties, and arrays of scalars, are expressible; a property whose type is
`object`, or an array of objects, needs this variable's shape extended.

access_log_group_name.description: CloudWatch Logs group name receiving API Gateway access logs.

authorizer_id.description: Cognito authorizer id — every method in this module references this one authorizer; exposed for the Layer 3 gate's authorizer-coverage assertion.

execution_arn.description: API execution ARN, for Lambda resource-policy `source_arn` patterns outside this module if needed.

private_origin_domain_name.description: Hostname for the CloudFront `/api/*` origin's `domain_name` (`<api-id>-<vpce-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com`). Sent as the Host header to the private API; requires no custom domain and no `x-apigw-api-id`. Uses the first entry of `vpc_endpoint_ids`.

route_tool_names.description: Sorted list of the tool names this module generated routes for, derived from `var.tool_lambda_invoke_arns`'s keys — for the Layer 3 gate to diff against `crm.toolspec.definitions.ALL_TOOLS`.

stage_invoke_url.description: Full invoke URL for the deployed stage. For this private API it is reachable only from inside the VPC through a named interface endpoint; it is not a publicly callable URL.

stage_name.description: Deployed stage name. Every route is served beneath it (`/<stage>/<tool_name>`), so a path-prefixed CloudFront behaviour in front of this API rewrites onto the stage path.

vpc_endpoint_ids.description: The `execute-api` interface endpoint ids this API is associated with and whose `aws:sourceVpce` its resource policy allows.

access_log_kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the API Gateway access log group at rest.

cognito_user_pool_arn.description: ARN of the Cognito user pool whose tokens the authorizer accepts (the `cognito` module user pool ARN output). A COGNITO_USER_POOLS authorizer validates that the token was issued by this pool; it does not validate the app-client audience.

extra_routes.description:
Routes that are not toolspec tools, and so are absent from `tool_lambda_invoke_arns`. Merged with
the tool map into the single local that generates every integration, route and permission, so
these carry the Cognito authorizer on the same terms as the tool routes.

The permitted keys are the allowlist validated below (`eval_trigger`, `capabilities`, `user_settings`).

`method` is the HTTP method the client calls and defaults to `POST`; `capabilities` is a browser
`GET` (`frontend/src/components/tuning/capabilityMatrix.ts`). The Lambda integration method is
always `POST` for `AWS_PROXY`, whatever the client method.

log_retention_days.description: Explicit CloudWatch Logs retention for the API Gateway access log group.

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already covers the mandatory tags; this allows a per-resource override or addition.

throttle_burst_limit.description: Per-route burst limit (concurrent requests) enforced at the default-route throttle setting.

throttle_rate_limit.description: Per-route steady-state rate limit (requests/second) enforced at the default-route throttle setting.

tool_lambda_function_names.description:
Map of tool_name -> that tool's action Lambda function name
(`module.lambda_action[tool_name].function_name`), used to grant API Gateway
`lambda:InvokeFunction` per function. Carries exactly the key set of `tool_lambda_invoke_arns`;
the REST API resource's precondition fails the plan otherwise.

tool_lambda_invoke_arns.description:
Map of tool_name -> that tool's action Lambda invoke ARN (`module.lambda_action[tool_name].invoke_arn`),
one entry per routed tool in `crm.toolspec.definitions.ALL_TOOLS`. Every route, integration and
authorizer attachment is generated from this map (see `main.tf`). Must not be empty.

vpc_endpoint_ids.description: The `execute-api` interface VPC endpoint ids this private API is reachable through. Sets `endpoint_configuration.vpc_endpoint_ids` and is the allowlist in the API resource policy.

alb_arn.description: Internal ALB ARN. The VPC origin references the ALB by this ARN, which is how CloudFront routes without resolving the origin's domain name.

alb_dns_name.description: Internal ALB DNS name, for diagnostics only. It is not the CloudFront origin `domain_name`, which is `module.api.private_origin_domain_name`: API Gateway routes the private API on that Host header.

alb_security_group_id.description: The ALB's security group id, for asserting its ingress source and single scoped egress.

listener_protocol.description: The listener protocol configured on the ALB, for a check asserting the deployed `HTTP` listener.

target_group_arn.description: Target group holding the execute-api endpoint ENI IPs, for the T3 check to assert target health from.

vpc_origin_id.description: Id of the CloudFront VPC origin. Goes into the distribution origin's `vpc_origin_config.vpc_origin_id` for the `/api/*` behaviour.

description.constant_value: Internal ALB fronting the private REST API for the CloudFront /api/* VPC origin
internal ALB to execute-api interface endpoint (443, TLS)

access_logs_bucket.description: S3 bucket receiving ALB access logs. Required.

access_logs_prefix.description: Key prefix the ALB writes access logs under. No default; it must equal the prefix in the destination bucket policy grant (`<bucket>/<this prefix>/AWSLogs/<account>/*`). The root passes one local to both sides.

alb_ingress_security_group_ids.description: Security group ids permitted to reach the ALB listener port: the security group the deployed CloudFront VPC origin presents. No default; see the first-deployment steps in `docs/runbook.md`.

execute_api_security_group_id.description: Security group id of the `execute-api` interface endpoint, the ALB single egress destination on 443.

execute_api_target_ips.description: Private IPv4 addresses of the `execute-api` interface endpoint's ENIs, one per entry in `private_subnet_ids`, resolved in the root. Registered as the target group's IP targets.

listener_port.description: ALB listener port. 80 with the `http-only` origin protocol policy; 443 only if an origin certificate exists, which requires a domain the owner controls.

listener_protocol.description: ALB listener protocol. `HTTP` on the CloudFront->ALB hop: an accepted deviation from encryption-in-transit on that hop only. The ALB->endpoint hop is HTTPS regardless.

name_prefix.description: Resource name prefix, from the root's `local.name_prefix`.

origin_protocol_policy.description: How CloudFront connects to the VPC origin. Defaults to `http-only`; `match-viewer` is rejected by validation, since the viewer is always HTTPS and this stack has no origin certificate.

private_subnet_ids.description: Private subnet ids for the ALB. Also fixes the plan-time count of endpoint ENIs, since the interface endpoint places one ENI per subnet (see the `count` note in main.tf).

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already covers the mandatory tags; this allows a per-resource override or addition.

vpc_id.description: Id of the adopted VPC the ALB and target group live in (`modules/vpc`'s vpc id output).

admin_group_name.description: Name of the Cognito group whose members are admin.

allowed_client_ids.description: The SPA and MCP app client ids, for Gateway #1's authorizer and interceptor `COGNITO_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS`. Excludes the MCP OAuth client.

chat_gateway_allowed_client_ids.description: `allowed_client_ids` plus the MCP OAuth client: Gateway #2's authorizer `allowed_clients` and its interceptor's `COGNITO_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS`.

chat_scope_identifier.description: Gateway #2's own `supervisor/chat` scope: its `CUSTOM_JWT` `allowedScopes`, the pre-token trigger's and interceptor's `CHAT_SCOPE`. Distinct from `gateway_scope_identifier`.

domain.description: Cognito user pool prefix domain (no custom ACM certificate). The base for the `/oauth2/token` token endpoint the MCP `client_credentials` flow mints against.

gateway_scope_identifier.description:
Fully-qualified `<identifier>/<scope_name>` custom scope
(`aws_cognito_resource_server.gateway.scope_identifiers[0]`) that the MCP app client's
`client_credentials` token carries, and the value the AgentCore Gateway's `CUSTOM_JWT` authorizer
allows (`allowedScopes`). The root composition consumes this output for both.

mcp_client_id.description: App client id for MCP clients (confidential client).

mcp_client_secret.description: App client secret for the MCP client. Sensitive; held in Terraform state and the gitignored results/tf-outputs.json, never in a tracked file. This stack creates no Secrets Manager entry for it.

mcp_oauth_client_id.description: App client id for interactive MCP OAuth clients (public client, no secret; Gateway #2 only).

spa_client_id.description: App client id for the SPA (public client, no secret).

user_pool_endpoint.description: Cognito user pool endpoint, used to derive the OIDC discovery and JWKS URLs.

scope_description.constant_value: Invoke the AgentCore Gateway MCP surface machine-to-machine.
Call chat_with_supervisor on the MCP chat Gateway.

description.constant_value: CRM eval administrators: live sweeps, cancel and unlock.

mcp_client_generate_secret.description:
Whether the MCP app client is confidential (generates a client secret) and uses
`client_credentials`. Defaults to true: the MCP client is a machine-to-machine caller. The stack
creates no Secrets Manager entry for the secret; see docs/mcp-client-guide.md.

mfa_configuration.description:
Pool-level MFA enforcement. Defaults to `OPTIONAL`; the SPA does not implement TOTP enrollment, so
`ON` makes interactive sign-in through the deployed frontend impossible. TOTP stays enabled either
way, so a user who enrolls is still challenged.

`OFF` is rejected by validation. Set `ON` once the frontend can complete
`MFA_SETUP`/`SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA`.

pre_token_generation_lambda_arn.description:
ARN of the pre-token-generation Lambda (V2 event) that stamps `custom:rep_id`,
`custom:book`, `custom:full_visibility`, and `custom:tenant` into the access
token. Created by the root composition and passed in.

pre_token_generation_lambda_function_nam.description:
Name of the pre-token-generation Lambda, used to scope the
`aws_lambda_permission` that lets Cognito invoke it. Must be the function
behind `pre_token_generation_lambda_arn`.

spa_callback_urls.description: Allowed OAuth callback URLs for the SPA app client.

spa_logout_urls.description: Allowed OAuth sign-out redirect URLs for the SPA app client.

user_pool_name.description: Name for the Cognito user pool.

gsi_arns.description:
Map of logical table name to a map of GSI name to that index's full ARN
(`<table_arn>/index/<gsi_name>`). Consumed by `infra/main.tf`'s per-tool
`dynamodb_grants[].index_arns`: every `dynamodb:Query` in this schema targets a named GSI (see
`crm.store.store.query_gsi`), so the grant names the index ARN.

kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting all eleven tables.

kms_key_id.description: Key ID of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting all eleven tables.

table_arns.description: Map of logical table name to table ARN.

table_names.description: Map of logical table name to physical DynamoDB table name.

table_stream_arns.description: Map of logical table name to stream ARN (null where streams are disabled).

description.constant_value: CMK for CRM DynamoDB table encryption at rest

account_id.description: Account id of the account-root statement in the CMK key policy.

administrator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs, or the account root, admitted to table and CMK administration. Every other principal is denied by the table and key policies.

caller_principal_arn.description: Role or user ARN of the principal running this plan. The table and key policies refuse to plan unless it is a listed administrator other than the account root, so no apply can lock its own caller out.

data_classification.description: Value for the `data-classification` tag on resources in this module.

data_plane_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs admitted to the tables' data plane and to the CMK's key use. Every other principal is denied by the table and key policies.

name_prefix.description: Prefix applied to table and alias names, e.g. tenant or environment scoping.

policy_arn.description: ARN of the ENI function-code Deny policy, passed to every `lambda_action` and `agent_relay` instantiation.

description.constant_value: Denies the Hyperplane ENI actions to Lambda function code; Lambda's own ENI management is unaffected.

name_prefix.description: Deployment name prefix, from the root composition's `local.name_prefix`. Part of the policy name.

artifact_prefix.description: The single key prefix artefacts are written under, and the only prefix the writer grant covers.

bucket_arn.description: ARN of the eval-artefacts bucket, for a consumer composing its own policy against it.

bucket_name.description: Name of the eval-artefacts bucket, which embeds the account id. Read by application code and the smoke suite.

access_log_bucket_id.description: Bucket id receiving this bucket S3 access logs. Must be a different bucket.

account_id.description: AWS account id, part of the globally-unique bucket name. Passed in by the caller so the module plans offline.

administrator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs, or the account root, admitted to bucket administration. Every other principal is denied it by the bucket policy.

artifact_prefix.description: Single key prefix all artefacts are written under, and the only prefix the writer grant covers.

artifact_retention_days.description:
Lifecycle expiry in days, applied to current objects, noncurrent versions and incomplete multipart
uploads alike. Artefacts are reproducible from a sweep with the same arguments and `dataset_seed`.

caller_principal_arn.description: Role or user ARN of the principal running this plan. The bucket policy refuses to plan unless it is a listed administrator other than the account root, so no apply can lock its own caller out.

data_plane_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs admitted to the bucket's object reads, lists and writes. Every other principal is denied them by the bucket policy.

kms_key_arn.description:
Customer-managed key ARN encrypting this bucket's objects, and the key the writer grant covers.
Created by the caller; it must be a dedicated key (see README).

name_prefix.description: Deployment name prefix, from the root composition's `local.name_prefix`. Part of the bucket name alongside the account id.

writer_role_name.description:

attaches nothing. The grant's scope comes from the policy's own resources, not from this value.

distribution_arn.description: ARN of the CloudFront distribution, used by the origin bucket policy's `AWS:SourceArn` condition.

kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the origin bucket.

logs_bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving S3 access logs and CloudFront access logs.

origin_bucket_arn.description: ARN of the private S3 origin bucket.

origin_bucket_name.description: Name of the private S3 bucket that holds the frontend static build.

comment.constant_value: Forward every viewer header except Host to the relay origin

description.constant_value: CMK for CRM frontend CDN origin bucket encryption at rest

administrator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs, or the account root, admitted to administration of the frontend CMK and the origin bucket. Every other principal is denied it.

agent_relay_function_name.description: The relay function name (`module.agent_relay.function_name`), for the distribution-scoped `lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl` permission this module declares.

api_gateway_domain_name.description: Origin hostname for the `/api/*` behaviour, from `module.api.private_origin_domain_name` (`<api-id>-<vpce-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com`). It is the `Host` header the private REST API routes on, not a name CloudFront resolves; the VPC origin routes by ALB ARN.

api_gateway_stage_name.description: Stage name the REST API serves its routes beneath (`infra/modules/api/` `stage_name`). The `/api/*` viewer-request function rewrites `/api/<tool>` to `/<stage>/<tool>`, since CloudFront forwards the viewer path to a custom origin unchanged.

api_origin_vpc_origin_id.description: Id of the CloudFront VPC origin fronting the private REST API (`module.api_origin.vpc_origin_id`), consumed by the `/api/*` origin `vpc_origin_config`.

caller_principal_arn.description: Role or user ARN of the principal running this plan. The key and origin-bucket policies refuse to plan unless it is a listed administrator other than the account root, so no apply can lock its own caller out.

data_classification.description: Value for the `data-classification` tag on resources in this module.

log_retention_days.description: Retention, in days, for the S3 bucket holding S3 access logs and CloudFront access logs.

name_prefix.description: Prefix applied to resource names, e.g. project or environment scoping.

operator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs of the operators: the only non-service principals admitted to frontend-CMK use and to writes into the origin bucket.

origin_noncurrent_version_retention_days.description: Days a superseded (noncurrent) object version in the origin bucket is kept before it expires. Current objects never expire.

function_name.description: The deployed Lambda function name.

invoke_arn.description: The function's invoke ARN, for wiring an API Gateway integration or a Gateway target.

log_group_name.description: This instantiation's CloudWatch Logs group name.

role_arn.description: This instantiation's dedicated execution role ARN.

role_name.description: This instantiation dedicated execution role name.

table_action_role_matrix_rows.description:
This instantiation's rows in the project-wide table × action × role matrix,
with `role` filled in from the actual generated role
name. The root composition collects every instantiation's rows (via
`flatten([for m in module.lambda_action : m.table_action_role_matrix_rows])`)
into one machine-readable file for the consolidated Layer 3 gate to assert
against.

attach_gateway_target_grant.description:
Whether to declare the Gateway-role invoke permission, as a plan-time-known flag. Must agree with
`gateway_target_role_arn` being non-`null`; a precondition on the permission asserts that.

denied_own_table_actions.description:
Per-action explicit denies on granted tables. Each entry names one granted table and the actions
this function is explicitly denied on it. Entries with an empty `actions` list are ignored.

denied_table_arns.description:
ARNs of every table this function is not granted access to via `dynamodb_grants`. The module
attaches one explicit `Deny` on the full `dynamodb:*` action surface for these resources. An empty
list is valid for a function with no DynamoDB grants; no dynamodb policy document is attached then.

dynamodb_allow_statements_per_policy.description:
With `dynamodb_policy_managed`, the most Allow statements one managed policy holds; the Allows
are split in lexical order of the grant index (0, 1, 10, 11, 2, …) into
`<function_name>-dynamodb-allow`, `-allow-2`, ... `null` keeps them in one policy.

dynamodb_grants.description:
Least-privilege per-table DynamoDB IAM grants for this function's execution role. Each entry names
one table (or one table's index) and the exact actions permitted on it. The validation blocks below
reject `dynamodb:*` actions and `Resource = "*"`.

`leading_key_condition` is optional and applies only where the table's partition key encodes the
caller's own identity (for example `reps`, keyed by `rep_id`). The four synthetic-id entity tables
(`accounts`, `contacts`, `opportunities`, `activities`) are keyed by the record's own id, so they
carry no `LeadingKeys` condition; rep-scoped isolation for them is enforced in `crm.authz`. See
`table_action_role_matrix.json` for the disposition per table.

dynamodb_kms_grant_enabled.description:
Whether to attach the `dynamodb_kms_key_arn` grant policy; it drives the policy's `count` with a
plan-time-known value. Set true exactly when `dynamodb_grants` is non-empty and the tables use a
customer-managed key; `dynamodb_kms_key_arn` must then be non-null.

dynamodb_kms_key_arn.description:
ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the DynamoDB tables named in `dynamodb_grants`
(`module.dynamodb.kms_key_arn`), for the role's `kms:Decrypt`/`kms:GenerateDataKey` grant. Required
whenever `dynamodb_grants` is non-empty.

dynamodb_policy_managed.description:
Attach the DynamoDB document as customer-managed policies instead of the inline
`<function_name>-dynamodb` policy: `<function_name>-dynamodb-allow` holds its Allow statements and
`<function_name>-dynamodb-deny` its Deny statements. For a role whose inline-policy aggregate nears
IAM's 10,240-char cap; each managed policy has its own 6,144-char cap and spends one of the role's
managed-policy attachments.

eni_function_code_deny_policy_arn.description: ARN of the managed policy denying the Hyperplane ENI actions to function code (`modules/eni_function_code_deny`). Attached to this function's role.

environment_kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the function environment variables. When null, Lambda uses its AWS-managed default key.

environment_variables.description: Plaintext environment variables for the function. Anything sensitive must instead be a Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store reference resolved at runtime, never an inline secret value.

filename.description: Path to the zipped deployment package for this function.

function_name.description: Unique Lambda function name. Also names this instantiation's dedicated IAM role, log group, and CloudWatch alarms.

gateway_target_role_arn.description:
The AgentCore Gateway target execution role ARN permitted to invoke this function via its resource
policy, the only non-API-Gateway principal admitted for a CRM tool. `null` declares no such
permission, for a function that is not a Gateway target.

reserved_concurrent_executions.description:
Reserved concurrency for this function. Must be greater than zero; 0 makes the function permanently
uninvokable, and the validation below rejects it.

Callers keep the sum of every instantiation's reserved concurrency, across the whole deployment,
below the account's concurrency pool (1,000 by default) minus the headroom the root composition
reserves for unreserved invocations. The root composition and the Layer 3 gate check that sum.

source_code_hash.description: Base64-encoded SHA256 of the deployment package, forcing redeploy on code change.

table_action_role_matrix_entries.description:
This instantiation's rows in the project-wide table × action × role matrix. Each entry records, for
one (table, action) pair this function is granted, whether `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` enforces rep
isolation or application code does. Not read at plan time by this module; the Layer 3 gate asserts
against it.

ingress.

vpc_subnet_ids.description:
Private subnet ids this function's Hyperplane ENIs are placed in (`module.vpc.lambda_subnet_ids`).
Required, with no default.

(`module.dynamodb.kms_key_arn`), for the role's `kms:Decrypt`/`kms:GenerateDataKey` grant. Required
whenever `dynamodb_grants` is non-empty.

dynamodb_policy_managed.description:
Attach the DynamoDB document as customer-managed policies instead of the inline
`<function_name>-dynamodb` policy: `<function_name>-dynamodb-allow` holds its Allow statements and
`<function_name>-dynamodb-deny` its Deny statements. For a role whose inline-policy aggregate nears
IAM's 10,240-char cap; each managed policy has its own 6,144-char cap and spends one of the role's
managed-policy attachments.

eni_function_code_deny_policy_arn.description: ARN of the managed policy denying the Hyperplane ENI actions to function code (`modules/eni_function_code_deny`). Attached to this function's role.

environment_kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the function environment variables. When null, Lambda uses its AWS-managed default key.

environment_variables.description: Plaintext environment variables for the function. Anything sensitive must instead be a Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store reference resolved at runtime, never an inline secret value.

filename.description: Path to the zipped deployment package for this function.

function_name.description: Unique Lambda function name. Also names this instantiation's dedicated IAM role, log group, and CloudWatch alarms.

gateway_target_role_arn.description:
The AgentCore Gateway target execution role ARN permitted to invoke this function via its resource
policy, the only non-API-Gateway principal admitted for a CRM tool. `null` declares no such
permission, for a function that is not a Gateway target.

reserved_concurrent_executions.description:
Reserved concurrency for this function. Must be greater than zero; 0 makes the function permanently
uninvokable, and the validation below rejects it.

Callers keep the sum of every instantiation's reserved concurrency, across the whole deployment,
below the account's concurrency pool (1,000 by default) minus the headroom the root composition
reserves for unreserved invocations. The root composition and the Layer 3 gate check that sum.

source_code_hash.description: Base64-encoded SHA256 of the deployment package, forcing redeploy on code change.

table_action_role_matrix_entries.description:
This instantiation's rows in the project-wide table × action × role matrix. Each entry records, for
one (table, action) pair this function is granted, whether `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` enforces rep
isolation or application code does. Not read at plan time by this module; the Layer 3 gate asserts
against it.

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already covers the mandatory tags; this allows a per-function override or addition.

vpc_security_group_ids.description:
Security groups for this function's ENIs (`module.vpc.lambda_security_group_ids`). The group has no
ingress.

vpc_subnet_ids.description:
Private subnet ids this function's Hyperplane ENIs are placed in (`module.vpc.lambda_subnet_ids`).
Required, with no default.

role_arn.description: Gateway #2 execution role ARN; the only Gateway principal admitted by the chat target's resource policy.

Send one message to the CRM supervisor agent and receive its answer. Pass the returned conversation_id on later calls to continue the same conversation.
The message to send, 1 to 8000 characters.
A conversation_id returned by an earlier call; omit to start a new conversation.

account_id.description: Account id for the trust policy's `aws:SourceAccount` and `aws:SourceArn` conditions and the interceptor permission's `source_account`.

aws_region.description: Region of the gateway; also the region segment of the trust policy's `aws:SourceArn` pattern.

chat_target_lambda_arn.description: ARN of the `chat_with_supervisor` target Lambda; the only target this gateway's role may invoke.

cognito_allowed_client_ids.description: Cognito app client ids the `CUSTOM_JWT` authorizer accepts, as on Gateway #1.

cognito_allowed_scopes.description: Scopes the `CUSTOM_JWT` authorizer accepts: this gateway's own chat scope, never Gateway #1's.

cognito_discovery_url.description: OIDC discovery URL of the Cognito user pool, as on Gateway #1.

identity_interceptor_lambda_arn.description: ARN of the shared REQUEST interceptor Lambda.

identity_interceptor_lambda_function_nam.description: Function name of the shared REQUEST interceptor Lambda, for this gateway's invoke permission.

role_name.description: Name of this gateway's own execution role.

tags.description: Tags for the gateway and its role. The provider's default_tags carries the mandatory set.

cloudtrail_access_logs_bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving the CloudTrail delivery bucket's own S3 server access logs (`aws_s3_bucket_logging.cloudtrail`'s target). Distinct from `cloudtrail_s3_bucket_name`, which is the source of those logs.

cloudtrail_arn.description: ARN of the CloudTrail trail for API activity.

cloudtrail_kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the CloudTrail S3 destination bucket.

cloudtrail_s3_bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket CloudTrail delivers log files to: the log source whose access logs land in `cloudtrail_access_logs_bucket_name`.

cloudwatch_logs_kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key for CloudWatch Logs log-group encryption. Sibling modules' `aws_cloudwatch_log_group` resources pass this as `kms_key_id`.

cloudwatch_logs_kms_key_id.description: Key ID of the customer-managed KMS key for CloudWatch Logs log-group encryption.

eval_metric_namespace.description: CloudWatch custom metric namespace reserved for eval-run metrics; passthrough of `var.eval_metric_namespace`.

description.constant_value: CMK for CloudTrail S3 log destination encryption at rest
CMK for CloudWatch Logs log group encryption at rest

administrator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs, or the account root, admitted to administration of both CMKs and of the CloudTrail bucket. Every other principal is denied it.

caller_principal_arn.description: Role or user ARN of the principal running this plan. The key and bucket policies refuse to plan unless it is a listed administrator other than the account root, so no apply can lock its own caller out.

cloudtrail_s3_log_retention_days.description: Lifecycle expiration, in days, for CloudTrail delivered log objects in the trail S3 destination bucket.

data_classification.description: Value for the `data-classification` tag on resources in this module.

enable_cloudtrail_cloudwatch_logs.description:
Whether the trail also delivers to a CloudWatch Logs log group (via
`cloud_watch_logs_group_arn`/`cloud_watch_logs_role_arn`), in addition to its S3 destination.
Defaults to false. The CMK this module creates already grants `logs.<region>.amazonaws.com` the
actions CloudWatch Logs needs.

eval_metric_namespace.description:
CloudWatch custom metric namespace reserved for eval-run metrics. No code
under `src/` publishes a CloudWatch metric; eval metrics are written to the
`matrix.json`/`.md`/`.csv` report files instead.

log_retention_days.description: CloudWatch Logs retention, in days, for the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration log group this module creates.

logs_key_user_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs admitted to key use on the CloudWatch Logs CMK: every execution role whose Lambda environment the key encrypts, plus the operators. Every other non-service principal is denied key use.

name_prefix.description: Prefix applied to resource names, e.g. project or environment scoping.

operator_principal_arns.description: IAM role or user ARNs of the operators: the only non-service principals admitted to CloudTrail-key use and to the CloudTrail bucket's data plane.

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already covers the mandatory tags; this allows a per-resource override or addition.

bedrock_agentcore_vpc_endpoint_id.description:
The `bedrock-agentcore` interface endpoint's id, for the runtime resource policies' `aws:SourceVpce`
condition: the Deny keyed on it denies every caller not arriving through this endpoint. Read from the
endpoint map by key. Fails at plan time if `bedrock-agentcore` is absent from the interface list.

execute_api_network_interface_ids.description:
The `execute-api` endpoint's ENI ids, for the private-origin ALB's target group.

`modules/api_origin` indexes this list positionally under `count = length(var.private_subnet_ids)`,
so it holds exactly one entry per private subnet; the precondition below asserts the length.

execute_api_security_group_id.description:
The security group on the `execute-api` endpoint's ENIs, and the ALB's single egress destination.
Every interface endpoint in this module shares it; its ingress is 443 from the Lambda group, plus
the ALB's 443 ingress rule, which the root composition attaches.

execute_api_vpc_endpoint_id.description:
The `execute-api` interface endpoint's id, for the private REST API's
`endpoint_configuration.vpc_endpoint_ids` and its resource-policy allowlist. Read from the endpoint
map by key. Fails at plan time if `execute-api` is absent from the endpoint list.

flow_log_group_name.description: The VPC flow-log group name, or null when flow logs are disabled. Read by the access-log delivery smoke check as its source-side target.

gateway_endpoint_service_names.description: Fully-qualified service names of the gateway endpoints created.

interface_endpoint_service_names.description: Fully-qualified service names of the interface endpoints created, for a Layer 4 check asserting the deployed set.

lambda_security_group_ids.description: The single Lambda security group, for the `security_group_ids` half of every Lambda `vpc_config`. No ingress.

lambda_subnet_ids.description: Private subnet ids, for the `subnet_ids` half of every Lambda `vpc_config`. Returns `var.private_subnet_ids` alone, sorted; a precondition in `nat.tf` asserts `var.nat_public_subnet_id` is absent from it.

nat_gateway_public_ip.description: The NAT gateway Elastic IP, or null when NAT is disabled. A Layer 4 check asserts the relay egress leaves by this address.

runtime_security_group_id.description:
The dedicated AgentCore Runtime security group's id, for the Runtime's VPC-mode
`network_mode_config.security_groups`. No ingress; egress only to the endpoint group and the gateway
prefix lists. Distinct from `lambda_security_group_ids`.

runtime_subnet_ids.description: The Runtime VPC-mode subnet ids, for the Runtime `network_mode_config.subnets`. Returns `var.runtime_subnet_ids` sorted. Empty when the Runtime is not in VPC mode.

states_vpc_endpoint_id.description:
The `states` interface endpoint's id, for the root's endpoint policy scoping it to the eval sweep.
Read from the endpoint map by key. Fails at plan time if `states` is absent from the
interface list.

flow_log_enabled.description:
Whether to deliver VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs. A plain `bool` input, so the flow-log `count`
is known at plan time.

flow_log_kms_key_arn.description: KMS customer-managed key ARN encrypting the flow-log group.

flow_log_retention_days.description: CloudWatch Logs retention, in days, for the flow-log group.

gateway_endpoint_service_names.description: Short service names for the gateway VPC endpoints (route-table entries, not ENIs); only `s3` and `dynamodb` support this form.

interface_endpoint_service_names.description:
Short service names for the interface (AWS PrivateLink) VPC endpoints this workload needs, e.g.
`["kms", "logs"]`. Each is expanded to `com.amazonaws.<region>.<name>`. A Lambda call to an AWS
service with no endpoint here presents as a connection timeout, not as an authorization error.

name_prefix.description: Prefix for every resource name and `Name` tag this module creates.

nat_gateway_enabled.description:
Whether to create the egress-only internet path: an EIP and NAT gateway in the adopted IGW-routed
subnet, the default route it adds to the adopted private route tables, and a 443-only egress rule on
the Lambda group. The NAT gateway admits no inbound connection, and the private subnets are never
associated with the public route table (see `nat.tf`).

No default; plan refuses until a value is set. With `false` the relay cannot fetch the Cognito JWKS
(the user pool has a domain, so the `cognito-idp` interface endpoint cannot serve it) and every agent
turn fails authentication. `true` creates a NAT gateway, billed hourly and per GB.

nat_public_subnet_id.description:
Id of an existing IGW-routed subnet in the adopted VPC for the NAT gateway to land in. Required when
`nat_gateway_enabled` is true; ignored otherwise. No default.

Must not appear in `private_subnet_ids`; a precondition on `aws_nat_gateway.this` in `nat.tf`
asserts that at plan time.

private_dns_disabled_services.description:
Interface-endpoint services whose private DNS is off. Defaults to `["execute-api"]`: private DNS on
an `execute-api` endpoint would resolve `*.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com` to this endpoint for
every workload in the adopted VPC. CloudFront routes to the VPC origin by load balancer ARN and uses
the hostname only as the `Host` header.

private_subnet_ids.description:
Ids of the existing private subnets in the adopted VPC to place Lambda ENIs in. No default.

These are the subnets whose route tables receive the NAT default route. They must be private; the
module cannot detect a public subnet from its id.

region.description: Region the endpoint service names are built for.

runtime_route_table_ids.description:
Route table ids of the Runtime subnets, associated with the S3/DynamoDB gateway endpoints so ECR
image-layer pulls have an S3 path. Separate from `private_route_table_ids`: these tables get no NAT
default route, so the Runtime has no internet path. Empty when the Runtime is not in VPC mode.

runtime_subnet_ids.description:
Subnet ids for the AgentCore Runtime's VPC-mode ENIs, separate from `private_subnet_ids` (which
feeds every interface endpoint's `subnet_ids` and the `execute-api` positional-length contract). The
Runtime reaches the interface endpoints through private DNS, so it needs no local endpoint ENI.

Empty when the Runtime is not in VPC mode. When non-empty, the subnets must be in AgentCore-supported
AZs for the region (`infra/regions.json`) and must not include `nat_public_subnet_id`;
`preflight_adopted_vpc.sh` asserts the AZs and the precondition below asserts the disjointness.

tags.description: Resource tags. The provider's default_tags already carries the mandatory tags; this adds or overrides per-resource.

vpc_cidr_block.description: The adopted VPC's IPv4 CIDR, used only for the `vpc_cidr_block` output that Layer 4 checks read.

vpc_id.description:
Id of the existing VPC to adopt. This module creates no VPC.

No default; set it through the gitignored tfvars. `terraform.tfvars.example` carries a placeholder.

agent_relay_function_name.description: The relay Lambda's function name, for the relay smoke check's `get-function-configuration` env-var assertions.

agent_relay_function_url.description: The relay Function URL, scheme included. The relay smoke check asserts an unauthenticated call to this hostname, not through the distribution, is denied.

agent_relay_log_group_name.description: The relay Lambda CloudWatch log group name, taken from `aws_cloudwatch_log_group.this.name`. Read by the relay-IAM smoke check to simulate `logs:CreateLogStream`/`logs:PutLogEvents` against the deployed group.

agent_relay_role_arn.description: The relay Lambda execution role ARN. Read by `scripts/smoke/iam_roles.py` to simulate the relay rows against the deployed role.

agentcore_gateway_mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint of Gateway #1: `agentcore_gateway_url` with the `/mcp` path, which the deployed `gatewayUrl` omits.

agentcore_runtime_log_group_name.description: CloudWatch Logs group name for the AgentCore Runtime's default endpoint stdout.

agentcore_runtime_role_arn.description: Execution role ARN of the AgentCore Runtime, the positive-control principal for the relay-IAM smoke check deny rows.

api_endpoint.description: The private REST API invoke hostname. Not a public endpoint: it is reachable only through the `execute-api` VPC endpoint, and CloudFront uses it only as a `Host` header. Use `api_id` to identify the API.

api_id.description: The REST API's id, read by `scripts/smoke/api_routes.py` to identify the API.

api_origin_alb_arn.description: Internal ALB fronting the private REST API. The CloudFront VPC origin references it by this ARN and performs no DNS lookup.

api_origin_alb_security_group_id.description: The ALB security group, the source of `aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.endpoints_from_api_origin_alb`. A T3 check asserts the endpoint group admits this group.

api_origin_listener_protocol.description: The listener protocol deployed on the ALB. A check asserts the `http-only` listener against the resource.

api_origin_target_group_arn.description: Target group holding the `execute-api` endpoint ENI IPs. A T3 check reads `describe-target-health` here.

api_origin_vpc_origin_id.description: Id of the CloudFront VPC origin, which `module.frontend_cdn` consumes as `api_origin_vpc_origin_id` for the `/api/*` origin `vpc_origin_config`. A T3 check asserts the deployed distribution routes `/api/*` through this origin.

api_stage_invoke_url.description: Full invoke URL for the deployed API stage.

cloudfront_distribution_id.description: CloudFront distribution id, used to invalidate cached assets after a frontend publish.

cloudfront_domain_name.description: CloudFront distribution domain name serving the frontend build.

cloudtrail_access_logs_bucket_name.description: Destination bucket for the CloudTrail delivery bucket S3 server access logs. Its log source is `cloudtrail_s3_bucket_name`, a different bucket.

cloudtrail_s3_bucket_name.description: The CloudTrail log-file delivery bucket, whose access logs land in `cloudtrail_access_logs_bucket_name`. Read by the delivery smoke check as the source side of its target assertion.

cognito_domain.description: Cognito prefix domain (no custom ACM certificate). Combine with `var.aws_region` as `https://<this>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com` to reach the `/oauth2/token` endpoint the MCP `client_credentials` flow uses; see `docs/mcp-client-guide.md`.

cognito_gateway_scope.description: The `gateway/invoke` resource-server scope identifier, re-exported from `module.cognito.gateway_scope_identifier`. Read by `scripts/smoke/gateway_tools.py`.

cognito_mcp_client_id.description: App client id for MCP clients (confidential client).

cognito_mcp_client_secret.description: App client secret for the MCP client, empty after the first secret rotation (`scripts/rotate_mcp_client_secret.py`). Sensitive; never write it to a tracked file. Any copy kept elsewhere, for example in Secrets Manager, is made out of band; nothing in this stack stores one.

cognito_mcp_oauth_client_id.description: App client id for interactive MCP OAuth clients (public client, authorization code, loopback callbacks); accepted by Gateway #2 only.

cognito_spa_client_id.description: App client id for the SPA (public client).

cognito_token_endpoint.description: Fully-formed Cognito `/oauth2/token` endpoint URL for the MCP app client's `client_credentials` grant.

crm_operator_principal_arns.description: The operator principals admitted by the DynamoDB table and CMK policies. Read by the Layer 4 `dynamodb_principal_deny` smoke check to assert the deployed policies' allowlists.

dynamodb_table_names.description: Map of logical table name to physical DynamoDB table name, for the 11 tables.

eval_artifacts_bucket_arn.description: The eval-artefacts bucket ARN, for a smoke check composing its own policy or simulation against it.

eval_artifacts_bucket_name.description: The eval-artefacts bucket name, which embeds the account id. Read by `sweep_control` (as EVAL_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET) and by the presigned-URL smoke check.

eval_artifacts_prefix.description: The single key prefix artefacts are written under, and the only prefix the `sweep_control` artifacts grant covers. Read by `sweep_control` as EVAL_ARTIFACTS_PREFIX.

eval_state_machine_arn.description: ARN of the eval_sweep Step Functions state machine, started by eval_trigger.

eval_trigger_function_name.description: The `eval_trigger` Lambda's function name. Read by the smoke checks: `admin_authz` derives the Lambda name prefix from it, `eval_sfn` and `chat_path_iam` read its configuration, and `resource_protection` checks its log group.

frontend_cdn_logs_bucket_name.description: Destination bucket for the CloudFront origin bucket and eval-artefacts bucket S3 server access logs, and for CloudFront standard access logs. Log sources: `frontend_origin_bucket_name`, `eval_artifacts_bucket_name`, and the distribution.

frontend_origin_bucket_name.description: Private S3 bucket holding the frontend static build — the `aws s3 sync` target of the deploy script's publish step.

mcp_chat_gateway_url.description: MCP endpoint URL of Gateway #2, which exposes only `chat_with_supervisor`.

vpc_flow_log_group_name.description: The VPC flow-log group name, or null when flow logs are disabled. Blocked egress appears here as REJECT records.

vpc_id.description: Id of the adopted VPC the stack deploys into. Read by the Layer 4 VPC smoke check.

vpc_interface_endpoint_service_names.description: Fully-qualified service names of the interface endpoints created: the AWS services the workload can reach privately. Read by checks that assert a dependency is reachable.

vpc_lambda_security_group_ids.description: The Lambda ENI security group. Read by Layer 4 to assert it has no ingress rule and no egress destination outside this VPC's endpoints.

vpc_lambda_subnet_ids.description: The private subnet ids every Lambda's `vpc_config` places ENIs in. Read by the Layer 4 VPC smoke check to assert each subnet's route table carries no route to a gateway.

description.constant_value: HTTPS from the private-origin ALB. The only ingress any endpoint has besides the Lambda group.

api_origin_ingress_security_group_ids.description:
Security group ids permitted to reach the internal ALB's listener port (the `/api/*` private origin
path). Passed to `modules/api_origin`, whose validation refuses anything that is not an `sg-` id.
No default; set it in the gitignored `terraform.tfvars`.

The value is the CloudFront service-managed group `CloudFront-VPCOrigins-Service-SG`, which AWS
creates in the adopted VPC when `aws_cloudfront_vpc_origin` is first applied. The first deployment
of this path is therefore two-phase: apply, read the group id, set this variable, apply again. See
the `api_origin` variables and the runbook.

aws_profile.description: Named AWS CLI profile to use for all provider operations.

aws_region.description: AWS region to deploy into: a US commercial region listed in `infra/regions.json`.

cost_center.description: Value for the mandatory `cost-center` tag applied to every resource.

crm_operator_principal_arns.description:
IAM role or user ARNs of the operators who deploy, seed and smoke-test this stack. Admitted to the
DynamoDB tables' data plane and to table and CMK administration; every principal outside these and
the project's Lambda roles is denied. No default; set it in the gitignored
`terraform.tfvars`. A plan whose caller is not listed fails at a precondition.

data_classification.description: Default value for the mandatory `data-classification` tag. Individual modules may override this per resource where a more specific classification applies.

environment.description: Value for the mandatory `environment` tag applied to every resource.

lambda_build_dir.description:
Directory holding the pre-built archives this composition reads, resolved
relative to `infra/`: one Lambda zip per `local.tool_names` entry, plus
`identity_interceptor.zip`, `pre_token_generation.zip`, `eval_trigger.zip`
(shared by the eval trigger, capabilities, user-settings and sweep functions),
`chat_target.zip` (the chat Gateway's target) and `relay.zip` — and
`agent-source.zip`, the CodeBuild source for the AgentCore container image. `scripts/package_lambdas.sh` and `scripts/package_relay.sh`
populate the default location, `infra/build/lambda`.

owner.description: Value for the mandatory `owner` tag applied to every resource.

runtime_source_vpce_deny_enabled.description:
Stage 2: whether the runtime resource policies carry the inbound Deny. When true, both policies deny
`InvokeAgentRuntime` from every principal not arriving through the bedrock-agentcore VPC endpoint
(with `aws:ViaAWSService = false` exempting internal service calls).

Defaults to false. Enable it only once the relay's calls are shown to carry `aws:SourceVpce`;
otherwise every chat turn is denied. Set `-var runtime_source_vpce_deny_enabled=true` (or in a
gitignored `*.auto.tfvars`) as a separate apply after stage 1 is verified.

runtime_source_vpce_report_only_enabled.description:
Stage 1: whether the runtime resource policies carry the report-only `aws:SourceVpce` Allow for any
principal arriving through the bedrock-agentcore VPC endpoint. It grants nothing the relay-role
Allow does not already cover for the relay; it shows, before the Deny, that traffic through this
stack's endpoint is admitted by the SourceVpce condition.

service.description: Value for the mandatory `service` tag applied to every resource.

vpc_cidr_block.description:
The adopted VPC's IPv4 CIDR, published as an output for Layer 4 checks. Nothing is sized from it.
It must match the adopted VPC.

vpc_flow_log_enabled.description: Whether to deliver VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs.

vpc_id.description:
Id of the existing VPC this deployment adopts. The stack creates no VPC; it creates only the NAT
gateway path, the route that path adds to the adopted private route tables, two security groups,
and the VPC endpoints.

No default. Set it in the gitignored `terraform.tfvars`; `terraform.tfvars.example` shows the shape
with a placeholder.

vpc_nat_gateway_enabled.description:
Whether to create the egress-only internet path the relay's Cognito JWKS fetch requires.

No default; `terraform plan` refuses until a value is set. `false` leaves the relay unable to
authenticate any request (the user pool has a domain, so the `cognito-idp` interface endpoint cannot
serve it). `true` creates a NAT gateway, billed hourly and per GB.

Set it on the command line (`-var vpc_nat_gateway_enabled=true`) or in a gitignored `*.auto.tfvars`.
The NAT gateway is egress-only: it admits no inbound connection (see `infra/modules/vpc/nat.tf`).

vpc_nat_public_subnet_id.description:
Id of an existing IGW-routed subnet in the adopted VPC for the NAT gateway to land in. Required when
`vpc_nat_gateway_enabled` is true; the plan fails otherwise. No default.

Must not also appear in `vpc_private_subnet_ids`; the module asserts that at plan time.

vpc_private_route_table_ids.description:
Route table ids the adopted private subnets use. No default.

Must not be the VPC's main route table; a precondition refuses it at plan time.

Every table named here receives a `0.0.0.0/0` route to this stack's NAT gateway and the S3/DynamoDB
gateway-endpoint associations.

vpc_private_subnet_ids.description:
Ids of the existing private subnets in the adopted VPC that every Lambda's ENIs are placed in. No
default; set it in the gitignored `terraform.tfvars`.

The AZ set is whatever these subnets are; it is not derived from the region.

vpc_runtime_route_table_ids.description:
Route table ids of the `vpc_runtime_subnet_ids` subnets, associated with the S3/DynamoDB gateway
endpoints so ECR image-layer pulls have an S3 path. They receive no NAT default route (that stays
on `vpc_private_route_table_ids`), so the Runtime has no internet path. Defaults to empty.

vpc_runtime_subnet_ids.description:
Ids of the private subnets for the AgentCore Runtime's VPC-mode ENIs, separate from
`vpc_private_subnet_ids` (see the vpc module's `runtime_subnet_ids`).

Every subnet must be in an AgentCore-supported AZ for the region (`infra/regions.json`) and must
not be `vpc_nat_public_subnet_id`; `scripts/preflight_adopted_vpc.sh` and a module precondition
assert both. The Runtime runs in VPC mode, so an empty list fails the plan.
